canonical_project: Noro Data Centre (Noro Fisheries MCS / Provincial Data Centre)
owner: Government of Solomon Islands (Western Provincial Government / FFA fisheries MCS; funded by World Bank/FFA/Australia)
notes: Prime Minister handed over the Noro Fisheries MCS Building and Provincial Data Centre in Noro, Western Province, 10-13 Nov 2025 (World Bank/FFA/Australia funded; contractors Reeves International and TCS International; Australia contributed AUD 1.3 million). Island Sun (12 Nov 2025) describes a government backup/DR role for critical records should Honiara be hit by major disasters. A-grade for announcement/location; operations and capacity details pending per SB methodology.
